purpose: Close only the r4 independent-QA authority, transition, snapshot, outer-label-firewall, and postcommit-recovery defects without changing the frozen scientific screen.

r5_required_closures.acyclic_authority: The immutable runner contains no actual authorization digest. A 64-lowercase-hex digest supplied only by P1_LONG_EVENT_SEGMENT_V2_AUTHORIZATION_SHA256 authenticates one held-open authorization byte sequence before parsing. The one-way lineage is runner -> seal -> independent QA -> authorization.
r5_required_closures.stable_readiness_digest: The sealed scientific/readiness verification payload excludes authorization-file existence, authorization digest, and live authorization state. A separate live authorization inspection is never part of the pinned readiness digest.
r5_required_closures.single_held_authority_lineage: Authorization, its pinned seal, independent QA, design, r5 amendment, and execution module are each read as one held byte snapshot, hashed before parsing/import, propagated into the private worker snapshot, and never accepted from a later unbound path reopen.
r5_required_closures.exact_worker_inventory: The worker requires exact equality with the authorization-authenticated seal inventory and runner-owned executable pins. Self-declared extra, missing, or substituted files fail before any project or numerical import and before claim.
r5_required_closures.outer_label_firewall: Before the all-fold outer prediction digest is journaled, only target-free frame, anchor, proposal, interval geometry, and candidate prediction bytes may be touched. Outer truth, anomaly_type, segment targets, precision, and every target-derived audit are first accessed inside terminal scoring after record_outer_freeze.
r5_required_closures.postcommit_recovery: If supervision fails after the final lock unlink and before stdout receipt, the parent performs only the same read-only completed-terminal/result/manifest verification and returns a deterministic recovered-success receipt without writes or rerun.
